```{r read-in-star-count-data}
# Read in count files from multiple samples
pman_count_files <- list.files(path = "RNAseq_count_files", pattern = "ReadsPerGene.out.tab", full.names = TRUE)

# Read first file to get gene names
count_data <- read.table(pman_count_files[1], header = FALSE, skip = 4)
gene_ids <- count_data[,1]

# Create count matrix using column 2 for unstranded
count_data <- sapply(pman_count_files, function(f) {
  example_count_file <- read.table(f, header = FALSE, skip = 4)
  example_count_file[,2] 
})

# fix row and column names to match gene ids and sample ids
rownames(count_data) <- gene_ids
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("_ReadsPerGene.out.tab", "", gsub("RNAseq_count_files/", "", pman_count_files))

# check dimensions
dim(count_data)

# import annotations and chromosome info
annotations <- flattenGTF("reference_files/annotations/GCF_049852395.1_HU_Pman_BW_mat_3.1_annotation.gtf", GTF.featureType = "gene", method = "merge")
genome_info <- read.csv("reference_files/annotations/GCF_049852395.1_chromosome_list.csv", header = TRUE)

# reformatting annotations and incorporating chromosome info
colnames(annotations) <- c("GeneID", "refseq_accession", "start", "end", "strand")
annotations <- merge(annotations, genome_info, by = "refseq_accession")
rownames(annotations) <- annotations$GeneID
annotations <- annotations[order(rownames(annotations)),]

# reorder chromosomes
chr_order <- paste("chr", c(seq(1,23), "X", "MT"), sep = "")
annotations$chr <- factor(annotations$chr, levels = chr_order)

# add in gene length
annotations$length <- annotations$end - annotations$start

# restrict to just genes found in count files
annotations <- annotations[annotations$GeneID %in% rownames(count_data),]

# check dimensions
dim(annotations)
```

<h3>Reformatting comp names</h3>
```{r renaming-acclimations-across-dfs}
# in preparation for DGE creation, make a dataframe of just gene name and counts
# match order of count dataframe to annotations
count_data <- count_data[order(rownames(count_data)),]
dim(count_data)

# change strain labels
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("^K", "KN_F4", colnames(count_data))
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("^M", "MBS_F5", colnames(count_data))

# change tissue labels
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("R$", "", colnames(count_data))
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("_T([0-4])$", "_testes_\\1", colnames(count_data))

# change acclimation labels
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("0$", "Control", colnames(count_data))
colnames(count_data) <- gsub("1$", "2day", colnames(count_data))
```

```{r}
#make a metadata df
metadata <- data.frame(mouse_id = colnames(count_data))
metadata <- metadata %>%
  separate(1, into = c("strain", "generation", "family", "individual", "tissue", "acclimation"), 
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$mouse_id
metadata$comp <- paste(metadata$strain, metadata$acclimation, sep = "_")

# remove outliers; this individual was found dead after an unknown period of time
outliers <- c("MBS_F5_812_E_testes_Control")
metadata <- metadata[!(metadata$mouse_id %in% outliers),]
count_data <- count_data[,!(colnames(count_data) %in% outliers)]

#subset count_data and metadata by tissue
count_data_testes <- count_data[,grep("testes", colnames(count_data))]
metadata_testes <- metadata[grep("testes", rownames(metadata)),]
```

```{r color-setup}
#a function to convert a vector from raw p-values to significance symbols
sig_conversion <- function(misc_dataframe) {
  triple <- misc_dataframe <= 0.001
  double <- misc_dataframe >= 0.001 & misc_dataframe<0.01 
  single <- misc_dataframe >= 0.01 & misc_dataframe<0.05 
  nonsig <- misc_dataframe >= 0.05 
  misc_dataframe[single] <- "*"
  misc_dataframe[double] <- "**"
  misc_dataframe[triple] <- "***"
  misc_dataframe[nonsig] <- "n.s."
  print(misc_dataframe)
}
```

<h3>Settings</h3>
```{r settings-and-base-expression-stats}
# set thresholds for determining if a gene is "expressed" by filterByExpr below
count.cutoff <- 10
min.reps <- 3

# methods used for normalizing data
norm.method <- "RLE"

# printing for record keeping purposes
print("Parameters Used:")
paste("All expressed genes have a minimum rpkm of:", count.cutoff, sep = " ")
paste("An expressed gene must be expressed in at least", min.reps, "samples", sep = " ")
paste("Counts are normalized with:", norm.method, sep = " ")

# normalize_dge reads in a dge, applies the rpkm and minimum replicate cutoffs for determining if a gene is expressed, then it re-normalizes the data using the normalization method specified above
normalize_dge <- function(dge_name) {
  #keep <- filterByExpr(dgeTestes, min.count = count.cutoff)
  
  keep_MBS <- filterByExpr(dgeTestes[, grep("MBS", dgeTestes$samples$group)], min.count = count.cutoff)
  keep_KN <- filterByExpr(dgeTestes[, grep("KN", dgeTestes$samples$group)], min.count = count.cutoff)
  keep <- keep_MBS & keep_KN
  
  dge_name <- dge_name[keep, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
  dge_name <- calcNormFactors(dge_name, method = norm.method)
}
```

<h1>Differential Expression Testes</h1>
<h3>Design set-up</h3>
```{r de-design-matrix}
#organizing metadata factors
metadata_testes$acclimation <- factor(metadata_testes$acclimation, levels = acclimations)
metadata_testes$strain <- factor(metadata_testes$strain, levels = strains)

#set up differential expression experimental design and contrasts
design <- metadata_testes[,c("mouse_id", "strain", "acclimation", "comp")]
design$comp <- factor(design$comp)

design_matrix_Testes <- model.matrix(~strain*acclimation, data=metadata_testes)
rownames(design_matrix_Testes) <- design$mouse_id
```

```{r Testes-edgeR-DE-run}
#run edgeR on Testes data; doesn't account for the severe LN family effects so ultimately, proceed with the dream analysis below
#fit Genewise Negative Binomial Generalized Linear Models with Quasi-Dispersion Estimation to the Testes data
Testes_model_fit <- glmQLFit(dgeTestes, design_matrix_Testes)
plotQLDisp(Testes_model_fit)
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
logFC_cutoff <- 1

#retrieve DE genes
#make a data frame that lists all the different factors that you could retrieve DE genes for and then the simpler name you want to refer to them by
factors_of_interest <- data.frame(factor_names = c("strainMBS",
                                                   "acclimation2day",
                                                   "acclimation2wk",
                                                   "acclimation6wk",
                                                   "strainMBS:acclimation2day",
                                                   "strainMBS:acclimation2wk",
                                                   "strainMBS:acclimation6wk"),
                                  coefficient_names =
                                    colnames(design_matrix_Testes)[-1])

retrieve_edgeR_DE_genes <- function(example_factor_name, example_coefficient_name){
  #run the QLF test on the given coefficient of interest
  example_QLF_test <- glmQLFTest(Testes_model_fit, 
                                 coef=grep(paste("^", example_coefficient_name, "$", sep = ""), colnames(design_matrix_Testes))) 
  
  topTags(example_QLF_test)
  example_DEs_Testes <- data.frame(topTags(example_QLF_test, n=dim(dgeTestes$counts)[1]))
  example_DEs_Testes$effect <- example_factor_name
  
  #logFC cutoff
  logFC_column_number <- grep("logFC", colnames(example_DEs_Testes))
  example_DEs_Testes <- example_DEs_Testes[abs(example_DEs_Testes[,logFC_column_number]) > logFC_cutoff,]
  
  if(dim(subset(example_DEs_Testes, FDR < fdr_cutoff))[1] > 0){
    #restrict to only significant DEs, if they exist
    example_DEs_Testes_sig <- subset(example_DEs_Testes, FDR < fdr_cutoff)
    example_DEs_Testes_sig$gene_ID <- rownames(example_DEs_Testes_sig)
    
    #restrict only to relevant columns so they can be bound with rbind later
    example_DEs_Testes_sig <- example_DEs_Testes_sig[c(1, logFC_column_number,
                                                       (length(colnames(example_DEs_Testes_sig))-3):
                                                         length(colnames(example_DEs_Testes_sig)))]
    
    #rename logFC column so it's consistent across QLF tests
    colnames(example_DEs_Testes_sig) <- gsub("logFC.*", "logFC", colnames(example_DEs_Testes_sig))
    
    print(paste("There are ", dim(example_DEs_Testes_sig)[1], 
                " genes that are significantly DE due to ", 
                example_factor_name, sep = ""
    ))
    write.csv(example_DEs_Testes_sig, file=paste("exported_files/EdgeR_DE_Testes_", 
                                                 example_factor_name, 
                                                 ".csv", 
                                                 sep = ""))
    
    #assign the example DE object to the specific DE object
    assign(paste(example_factor_name, "_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig", sep = ""),
           example_DEs_Testes_sig,
           envir = .GlobalEnv)
    
    #return the list of DE genes
    return(example_DEs_Testes_sig)
  }
}

#run the retrieve DE genes function on all factors of interest
#creates objects ending in "edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig"
invisible(mapply(retrieve_edgeR_DE_genes,
                 factors_of_interest[,1],
                 factors_of_interest[,2]))
```

```{r gProfileR-DE}
#get_go_edgeR_subsets function tests DE genes for each main effect DE gene set for GO enrichment
get_go_edgeR_subsets <- function(effect) {
  #retrieve genes belonging to specific DE term
  effect_genes <- table_edgeR_DEs[table_edgeR_DEs$effect == effect,]$gene_ID
  
  go_terms_effect_df <- gost(query = effect_genes, 
                             organism = "pmbairdii", 
                             multi_query = FALSE, significant = TRUE,  
                             user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                             domain_scope = "custom", custom_bg = dgeTestes$genes$GeneID, 
                             numeric_ns = "", as_short_link = FALSE, highlight = TRUE,
                             evcodes = TRUE, sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))
  
  assign(paste("go_terms", effect, "df", sep = "_"), go_terms_effect_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  if(sum(go_terms_effect_df$result$significant == TRUE) == 0) {
    return(paste("There are no significant GO terms for ", 
                 effect," effect", sep = ""))
  } else {
    return(paste("There are ", sum(go_terms_effect_df$result$significant == TRUE),
                 "significant GO terms for ", effect," effect", sep = ""))
  }
}

go_results_edgeR <- lapply(unique(table_edgeR_DEs$effect), get_go_edgeR_subsets)

#test if genes expressed in the testes and also PBS outliers are enriched for any GO terms
go_terms_PBS_DEs_df <- gost(query = dgeTestes$genes$GeneID[dgeTestes$genes$GeneID %in% pbs_outliers], 
                            organism = "pmbairdii", 
                            multi_query = FALSE, significant = TRUE,  
                            user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                            domain_scope = "custom", custom_bg = dgeTestes$genes$GeneID, 
                            numeric_ns = "", as_short_link = FALSE, highlight = FALSE,
                            evcodes = TRUE, sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))


# exporting strainMBS go terms for supplemental Table S9
strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted <- go_terms_strainMBS_df$result

#calculate the fold enrichment for each term based on genome-wide expectations
strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$exp <- strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$query_size*
  (strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$term_size/strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$effective_domain_size)
strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$fold.enrichment <- strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$intersection_size/strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$exp

strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted <- strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted[,c("term_name", 
                                                                  "p_value", 
                                                                  "highlighted", 
                                                                  "fold.enrichment", 
                                                                  "source", 
                                                                  "term_id", 
                                                                  "term_size", 
                                                                  "query_size", 
                                                                  "intersection_size",
                                                                  "intersection")]
strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$p_value <- formatC(strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$fold.enrichment <- round(strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$fold.enrichment, 2)

#write combined DE lists out to file to generate Table S9
write.csv(strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted, file="exported_files/strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# plot GO enrichment for strain-specific DE genes for table S4
source_colors <- c("#BCB6B3", "#776E69", "#191716")
names(source_colors) <- c("GO:BP", "GO:CC", "GO:MF")

strain_MBS_GO_terms_plot <- ggplot(

  aes(x = fold.enrichment, y = reorder(term_name, fold.enrichment),
      size = intersection_size, fill = source)) +
  geom_point(pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = source_colors[names(source_colors) %in% unique(strain_MBS_GO_terms_formatted$source)]) +

        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

strain_MBS_GO_terms_plot

ggsave("exported_figures/figure_s4_strain_MBS_GO_terms_plot.pdf",
```

```{r pbs-outliers}
#test if PBS outliers are enriched in strain-specific DE genes
pbs_outliers_DE <- strainMBS_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig[strainMBS_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig$gene_ID %in%
                                                    pbs_outliers_expressed,]
go_terms_pbs_df <- gost(query = pbs_outliers_DE$gene_ID, 
                        organism = "pmbairdii", 
                        multi_query = FALSE, significant = FALSE,  
                        user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                        domain_scope = "custom", 
                        custom_bg = strainMBS_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig$gene_ID, 
                        numeric_ns = "", as_short_link = FALSE, highlight = TRUE,
                        evcodes = TRUE, sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))

#test if there are more or less PBS outliers in the DE gene set than expected by chance
# total genes
N <- length(rownames(dgeTestes$genes))
# number of expressed PBS outliers
K <- length(pbs_outliers_expressed)
# number of DE genes
n <- length(strainMBS_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig$gene_ID)
# observed overlap
x <- sum(strainMBS_edgeR_DEs_Testes_sig$gene_ID %in%
           pbs_outliers_expressed)                

# probability that there are fewer PBS outliers in the DE gene set than expected
p_depletion <- phyper(x, K, N - K, n)
p_depletion

# expected overlap
cat("N:", N, "\n",
    "K:", K, "\n",
    "n:", n, "\n",
    "x:", x, "\n",
    "expected overlap:", n * K / N, "\n")
```

```{r Testes-WGCNA-expression-setup}
#examine individual genes and individual samples and remove outliers before building gene network
#create transposed expression data frame
testes_cpm <- read.csv(file = "exported_files/testes_cpm_norm_counts.csv", row.names = 1)
testes_expr_filtered <- data.frame(t(testes_cpm[,grep("testes", colnames(testes_cpm))]))

#This function checks data for missing entries, entries with weights below a threshold, and zero-variance genes, and returns a list of samples and genes that pass criteria on maximum number of missing or low weight values. In the example, all genes and all samples pass this quality check
gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(testes_expr_filtered, verbose = 3)

#lets you know if every gene/individual passes filter; everything does but the removal of offender genes/individuals is below
gsg$allOK

#if not all genes and samples pass the criteria, remove them
if (!gsg$allOK) {
  # Optionally, print the gene and sample names that were removed:
  if (sum(!gsg$goodGenes) > 0)
    printFlush(paste("Removing genes:", paste(names(testes_expr_filtered)[!gsg$goodGenes], collapse = ", ")))
  if (sum(!gsg$goodSamples) > 0)
    printFlush(paste("Removing samples:", paste(rownames(testes_expr_filtered)[!gsg$goodSamples], collapse = ", ")))
  # Remove the offending genes and samples from the data:
  testes_expr_filtered <- testes_expr_filtered[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
}

#when all genes and samples pass the criteria, keep them in the filtered expression object
if (gsg$allOK) {
  testes_expr_filtered <- testes_expr_filtered
}

#clustering samples to look for outliers
sampleTree = hclust(dist(testes_expr_filtered), method = "average")

# Plot the sample tree: Open a graphic output window of size 12 by 9 inches
# The user should change the dimensions if the window is too large or too small.
sizeGrWindow(12,9)

pdf(file = "exported_figures/testes_sample_clustering.pdf", width = 12, height = 9)

par(cex = 0.6)

par(mar = c(0,4,2,0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "testes sample clustering to detect outliers", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5,
     cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)
dev.off()

par(cex = 0.6)

par(mar = c(0,4,2,0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "testes sample clustering to detect outliers", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5,
     cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)
```

```{r WGCNA-choose-beta-and-construct-network}
# Choose a set of soft-threshold powers for WGCNA
# only choose once so set run_WGCNA <- TRUE for first time use
if(run_WGCNA) {
  # test a wide range of beta values
  powers <- c(c(1:10), seq(12, 20, 2))
  
  soft_threshold_testes <- pickSoftThreshold(testes_expr_filtered, 
                                             powerVector = powers, 
                                             verbose = 5)
  
  # plot the scale free and topology and mean connectivity for each beta value to choose best
  scale_free_topology_plot <- ggplot(soft_threshold_testes$fitIndices, aes(x = Power, y = SFT.R.sq, bel = Power)) +
    geom_text(size = 5, color = MBS_Control_color, aes(label = Power)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.93, color = MBS_Control_color) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x="Soft Threshold (power)", y="Scale Free Topology Model Fit,signed R^2")
  
  mean_connectivity_plot <- ggplot(soft_threshold_testes$fitIndices, aes(x = Power, y = mean.k., bel = Power)) +
    geom_text(size = 5, color = MBS_Control_color, aes(label = Power)) + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x="Soft Threshold (power)", y="Mean Connectivity")
  
  print(plot_grid(scale_free_topology_plot,
                  mean_connectivity_plot,
                  nrow = 1, align = "v"))
  
  #plot of beta values; save to pdf
  ggsave("exported_figures/rv_beta_plot_testes.pdf",   
         plot_grid(scale_free_topology_plot,
                   mean_connectivity_plot,
                   nrow = 1, align = "v"),
         height = 4, width = 7)
  
} else {
  print("Using a previously generated WGCNA network")
}
```

```{r WGCNA-network-construction}
# construct gene network; only run once because there is randomness in network construction
# set run_WGCNA <- TRUE for first time use
if(run_WGCNA){
  cor <- WGCNA::cor
  
  #build blockwise modules
  testes_network <- blockwiseModules(testes_expr_filtered, 
                                     power = 8, 
                                     maxBlockSize = dim(testes_expr_filtered)[2],
                                     TOMType = "signed", 
                                     networkType = "signed", 
                                     minModuleSize = 30,
                                     reassignThreshold = 0, 
                                     mergeCutHeight = 0.20,
                                     numericLabels = TRUE, 
                                     pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
                                     saveTOMs = TRUE,
                                     saveTOMFileBase = "exported_files/ExprTOM_testes",
                                     verbose = 3)
  save(testes_network,file = "exported_files/spermoxia_testes_Network.RData")
} else { 
  load(file = "exported_files/spermoxia_testes_Network.RData") #load saved Network file
}

#assign modules to color labels; should have seven modules including gray
table(testes_network$colors)
testes_module_labels <- testes_network$colors
testes_module_colors <- labels2colors(testes_network$colors)
table(testes_module_colors)
dim(table(testes_module_colors))

testes_module_color_info <- data.frame(table(testes_module_colors))
testes_module_color_info$number <- rownames(testes_module_color_info)
color_convert <- testes_module_color_info[c("testes_module_colors", "number")]
colnames(color_convert) <- c("color", "number")

#To quantify co-expression similarity of entire modules, we calculate their eigengenes and cluster them on their correlation:
#define the MEs present in testes
testes_MEs <- moduleEigengenes(testes_expr_filtered, testes_module_colors)$eigengenes
testes_MEs <- orderMEs(testes_MEs) #the rownames of this dataset are equal to Expr

#calculate intra-module connectivity for each gene
testes_kME <- signedKME(testes_expr_filtered, testes_MEs)

# Calculate dissimilarity of module eigengenes
testes_ME_dissimilarity <- 1-cor(testes_MEs);
# Cluster module eigengenes
testes_ME_tree <- hclust(as.dist(testes_ME_dissimilarity), method = "average");
# Plot the result
sizeGrWindow(7, 6)
plot(testes_ME_tree, main = "Clustering of module eigengenes", xlab = "", sub = "")

write.csv(testes_module_color_info,
          file="exported_files/testes_module_table.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(color_convert,
          file="exported_files/testes_color_convert.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

#number of genes assigned to modules
length(testes_module_colors)
dim(table(testes_module_colors))

#plot module dendograms
testes_gene_tree <- testes_network$dendrograms[[1]]

# open a graphics window
sizeGrWindow(12, 9)
# Convert labels to colors for plotting
mergedColors <- labels2colors(testes_network$colors)
# Plot the dendrogram and the module colors underneath
plotDendroAndColors(testes_network$dendrograms[[1]], mergedColors[testes_network$blockGenes[[1]]],
                    "Module colors",
                    dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05)
```

```{r WGCNA-trait-module-associations-NSC}
# perform Trait Module Associations
#perform analysis of Normalized_Sperm_Count data for all individuals sequenced for at least one trait; then restrict to testes only samples
#refine trait list to those of interest then omit NA individuals
testes_trait_data_NSC <- phenotypes
testes_trait_data_NSC <- testes_trait_data_NSC[!is.na(testes_trait_data_NSC$Normalized_Sperm_Count),]

testes_trait_data_NSC <- phenotypes[,c("mouse_id", "Normalized_Sperm_Count")]
rownames(testes_trait_data_NSC) <- testes_trait_data_NSC$mouse_id

# Define numbers of genes and samples
nGenes <- ncol(testes_expr_filtered)
nSamples <- nrow(testes_expr_filtered)

#define the MEs present in testes
testes_MEs <- moduleEigengenes(testes_expr_filtered, testes_module_colors)$eigengenes
testes_MEs <- orderMEs(testes_MEs) #the rownames of this dataset are equal to Expr

#merge the MEs with the trait data and then sample info for correlations
#first the trait data
testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC <- merge(testes_MEs, phenotypes, by.x = 0, by.y = "mouse_id", all.y = TRUE)
rownames(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC) <- testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC$Row.names

#reformat from wide to long
testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long <- pivot_longer(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC, 
                                                col = grep("^ME", colnames(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC)),
                                                names_to = "module", values_to = "ME")
testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$module <- gsub("^ME", "", testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$module)
testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$group <- factor(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$comp,
                                                levels = combinations)

#export table of module eigengene x normalize sperm count correlations
write.csv(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long, 
          file = "exported_files/testes_module_eigengenes_NSC.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#run the trait correlations
testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC <- testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC[,grep("grey", colnames(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC), invert = TRUE)]
testes_ME_trait_correlations_NSC <- round(cor(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC[,grep("^ME", colnames(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC))], 
                                              testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC[,grep("Normalized_Sperm_Count", colnames(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC))], 
                                              use = "p"), 3)
testes_module_trait_pValues_NSC <- round(corPvalueStudent(testes_ME_trait_correlations_NSC, nSamples), 3)
testes_module_trait_fdr_NSC <- as.data.frame(p.adjust(testes_module_trait_pValues_NSC[,1], method="fdr"))
testes_NSC_trait_cor <- cbind(testes_module_trait_pValues_NSC, testes_module_trait_fdr_NSC)
colnames(testes_NSC_trait_cor) <- c("p-value", "q-value")

#determine which modules have significant trait correlations
sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC <- testes_module_trait_pValues_NSC[apply(testes_module_trait_pValues_NSC, MARGIN = 1, function(x) any(x <= 0.05)), ]
sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC <- data.frame(sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC)
write.csv(sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC, file="exported_files/testes_module_trait_correlation_NSC.csv")

#pull out modules with significant correlations
correlated_mods_NSC <- sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC[sig_testes_trait_modules_NSC$Normalized_Sperm_Count <= 0.05,]
correlated_mods_pearson_NSC <- testes_ME_trait_correlations_NSC[rownames(testes_ME_trait_correlations_NSC) %in%
                                                                  rownames(correlated_mods_NSC),]
#combine pearson's r with p-values
correlated_mods_table_NSC <- cbind(testes_ME_trait_correlations_NSC,
                                   testes_NSC_trait_cor)
colnames(correlated_mods_table_NSC) <- c("r", "p-value", "q-value")
rownames(correlated_mods_table_NSC) <- gsub("^ME", "", rownames(correlated_mods_table_NSC))

#convert modules names from colors to numbers using existing table
color_convert <- read.csv("exported_files/testes_color_convert.csv")
correlated_mods_table_NSC <- merge(correlated_mods_table_NSC,
                                   color_convert, 
                                   by.x=0,
                                   by.y="color")

#reorder by module number then export all modules
correlated_mods_table_NSC <- correlated_mods_table_NSC[order(correlated_mods_table_NSC$number),]
colnames(correlated_mods_table_NSC) <- gsub("Row.names", "module", colnames(correlated_mods_table_NSC))
write.csv(correlated_mods_table_NSC, "exported_files/testes_wgcna_correlation_table_all_NSC.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r lmer-on-module-eigengenes}
#test for associations between treatments and module eigengenes with lms
# module membership info
gene_module_membership <- data.frame(cor(testes_expr_filtered, testes_MEs, use = "p"))
module_membership_pvalues <- data.frame(corPvalueStudent(as.matrix(gene_module_membership), nSamples));
colnames(gene_module_membership) <- gsub("ME", "MM.", colnames(gene_module_membership))

#make summary dataframe for each gene and it's module info
gene_info_testes <- data.frame(Gene = names(testes_expr_filtered),
                               moduleColor = testes_module_colors,
                               moduleLabel = testes_module_labels,
                               gene_module_membership,
                               module_membership_pvalues)

#export table
write.csv(gene_info_testes, file="exported_files/gene_info_testes.csv")

# subset by module
subset_gene_info <- function(which_module) {
  tmp_color_df <- subset(gene_info_testes, moduleColor == which_module)
  assign(paste(which_module, "df", sep = "_"), tmp_color_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
}
invisible(lapply(unique(gene_info_testes$moduleColor), subset_gene_info))

#make a list of all genes included in the testes WGCNA analysis
testes_wgcna_genes <- names(testes_expr_filtered)

# LMER on module eigengenes
# run linear mixed effects module on module eigen genes and the associated experimental factors
testes_lmer_model <- lapply(
  split(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long[testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$module != "grey",],
        testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long[testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long$module != "grey",]$module),
  function(df) {
    df <- droplevels(df)
    lmer(ME ~ strain * acclimation + (1 | strain:family),
         data = df)
  }
)
#run the summary function on all of the lmers; output anova table from model results
testes_lmer_model_summaries <- lapply(testes_lmer_model, summary)

#create a dataframe of the pvalues resulting from the lmer tests on all modules
testes_lmer_model_pvalues <- data.frame()

for(module_color in names(testes_lmer_model_summaries)){
  lmer_pvalues <- testes_lmer_model_summaries[[which(names(testes_lmer_model_summaries) %in% module_color)]]$coefficients[,5]
  lmer_pvalues <- data.frame(t(lmer_pvalues))
  colnames(lmer_pvalues) <- c("Intercept",
                              "strainMBS",
                              "acclimation2day",
                              "acclimation2wk",
                              "acclimation6wk",
                              "strainMBS:acclimation2day",
                              "strainMBS:acclimation2wk",
                              "strainMBS:acclimation6wk")
  rownames(lmer_pvalues) <- module_color
  lmer_pvalues$module <- module_color
  testes_lmer_model_pvalues <- rbind(testes_lmer_model_pvalues, lmer_pvalues)
}

#remove intercept column
testes_lmer_model_pvalues <- testes_lmer_model_pvalues[,-1]

#reformat to long version
testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long <- pivot_longer(testes_lmer_model_pvalues, 
                                               col = grep("module",
                                                          colnames(testes_lmer_model_pvalues),
                                                          invert = TRUE),
                                               names_to = "comparison",
                                               values_to = "pvalue")

#convert modules names from colors to numbers using existing table from above
testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long <- merge(color_convert, 
                                        testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long, 
                                        by.x="color", 
                                        by.y="module")
colnames(testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long) <- gsub("color", "module", colnames(testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long))

lmer_effect_parsing <- function(comparison, coefficient_name) {
  subset_testes_lmer_pvalues <- testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long[testes_lmer_model_pvalues_long$comparison == coefficient_name,]
  subset_testes_lmer_pvalues$fdr <- p.adjust(subset_testes_lmer_pvalues$pvalue, method="fdr")
  subset_sig_testes_modules <- data.frame(subset(subset_testes_lmer_pvalues, pvalue <= 0.05))
  dim(subset_sig_testes_modules)
  subset_sig_testes_modules$module <- gsub("^ME", "", subset_sig_testes_modules$module)
  write.table(subset_sig_testes_modules, 
              file=paste("exported_files/testes_module_lmer_significant_modules_", 
                         comparison, ".txt", sep = ""), 
              col.names=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
  assign(paste(comparison, "_sig_testes_modules_df", sep = ""),
         subset_sig_testes_modules, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  return(paste("There are ", 
               dim(subset_sig_testes_modules)[[1]], 
               " modules significant for the ", 
               comparison, 
               " effect", 
               sep = ""))
}

#retrieve modules that have significant effects in response to the experimental variables after FDR correction and create dataframe objects of the significant modules
mapply(lmer_effect_parsing,
       factors_of_interest[,1],
       factors_of_interest[,2])

#bind all the significant module dataframes together

# convert p values to symbols for plotting
get_sig_effects_label <- function(which_module, alpha = 0.05) {
  coefs <- as.data.frame(testes_lmer_model_summaries[[which_module]]$coefficients)
  coefs$term <- rownames(coefs)
  
  sig_terms <- coefs %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)", `Pr(>|t|)` < alpha) %>%
    mutate(stars = case_when(
      `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(term, ": p = ", signif(`Pr(>|t|)`, 2), stars))
  
  if (nrow(sig_terms) == 0) {
    return("No significant effects")
  }
  
  sig_terms$label <- gsub("MBS:", " x ", sig_terms$label)
  sig_terms$label <- gsub("acclimation", "", sig_terms$label)
  sig_terms$label <- gsub("wk", " week exposure", sig_terms$label)
  paste(sig_terms$label, collapse = "\n")
}

# for each module of interest, plot the mean and SEM expression across groups
make_module_eigengene_plot <- function(which_module) {
  sig_label <- get_sig_effects_label(which_module)
  
  ggplot(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long %>%
           filter(module %in% which_module), 
         aes(x = acclimation, y = ME, color = strain, fill = strain)) + 
    geom_boxplot(width=.4, position = position_dodge(0.75), linewidth = 0.6, outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, notch = FALSE, aes(color = strain)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = 0.3, 
               size = 2, fill = NA) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = sig_label,
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, fontface = "italic") +
    xlab("Hypoxia exposure") +
    ylab(paste(which_module, " module eigengene", sep = "")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(MBS = "#254869", KN = "#8e260b")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(MBS = "#254869", KN = "#8e260b")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control" = "0 days", "2day" = "2 days",
                                "2wk" = "2 weeks", "6wk" = "6 weeks")) +

         max(testes_MEs_wtrait_data_NSC_long %>% filter(module %in% which_module) %>% select(ME)) + 0.2) +

}
```

```{r gProfileR-modules}
# a function to test if each module is enriched for any GO terms
get_go_module_subsets <- function(color) {
  #retrieve genes belonging to specific module
  tmp_color_df <- subset(gene_info_testes, moduleColor == color)
  assign(paste(color, "df", sep = "_"), tmp_color_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  go_terms_color_df <- gost(query = tmp_color_df$Gene, 
                            organism = "pmbairdii", 
                            multi_query = FALSE, significant = TRUE,  
                            user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                            domain_scope = "custom", custom_bg = testes_wgcna_genes, 
                            numeric_ns = "", as_short_link = FALSE, highlight = TRUE,
                            evcodes = TRUE, sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))
  
  assign(paste("go_terms",color, "df", sep = "_"), go_terms_color_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # if there are no significant GO terms, return negative statement
  if(sum(go_terms_color_df$result$significant == TRUE) == 0) {
    return(paste("There are no significant GO terms for ", 
                 color," module", sep = ""))
  } else {
    # if there are signficiant GO terms, calculate the fold enrichment and save to df
    go_terms_color_df_results <- go_terms_color_df$result
    go_terms_color_df_results$exp <- go_terms_color_df_results$query_size*
      (go_terms_color_df_results$term_size/go_terms_color_df_results$effective_domain_size)
    go_terms_color_df_results$fold.enrichment <- go_terms_color_df_results$intersection_size/go_terms_color_df_results$exp
    
    assign(paste("go_terms",color, "results_df", sep = "_"), go_terms_color_df_results, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    
    return(paste("There are ", sum(go_terms_color_df$result$significant == TRUE),
                 "significant GO terms for ", color," module", sep = ""))
  }
}

invisible(lapply(unique(testes_module_colors), get_go_module_subsets))

#for each module, make a plot of the significant GO terms by fold.enrichment and gene number
```

```{r apopotosis}
# investigate if apopotosis genes have a universal shift in expression in any treatment
apoptosis_parent_ID <- "GO:0006915"
#negative_apoptosis <- "GO:0043066"
#positive_apoptosis <- "GO:0043065"

#get the child terms for the chosen GO term
descendants <- as.list(GOBPOFFSPRING)[[apoptosis_parent_ID]]  # all child terms in Biological Process ontology
all_ids <- unique(c(apoptosis_parent_ID, descendants))

#fetch apoptosis gene metadata
apoptosis_genes <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys    = all_ids,
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", "GENENAME"),
  keytype = "GO"
)

apoptosis_genes <- unique(apoptosis_genes[, c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", "GENENAME")])
colnames(apoptosis_genes) <- c("GeneID", "ENTREZID", "GENENAME")

print(paste("Genes under GO:0006915 (apoptotic process) and descendants:",
            nrow(apoptosis_genes), sep = " "))

print(paste("Of these,", sum(rownames(dgeTestes) %in% apoptosis_genes$GeneID),
            "are expressed in the dataset"), sep = "")

#testing for shifts in expression across groups
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
logFC_cutoff <- 0

# get a vector of the group each sample belongs to
sample_group <- factor(dgeTestes$samples$group,
                       levels = c("KN_Control", "KN_2day", "KN_2wk", "KN_6wk",
                                  "MBS_Control", "MBS_2day", "MBS_2wk", "MBS_6wk"))

#make a new differential expression design matrix to test if apoptosis changes across hypoxia exposure /within/ each strain
design_group <- model.matrix(~ 0 + sample_group)
colnames(design_group) <- levels(sample_group)

dgeTestes <- estimateDisp(dgeTestes, design_group)
Testes_model_fit <- glmQLFit(dgeTestes, design_group)

cons <- makeContrasts(
  KN_2day_vs_Ctrl  = KN_2day  - KN_Control,
  KN_2wk_vs_Ctrl   = KN_2wk   - KN_Control,
  KN_6wk_vs_Ctrl   = KN_6wk   - KN_Control,
  MBS_2day_vs_Ctrl = MBS_2day - MBS_Control,
  MBS_2wk_vs_Ctrl  = MBS_2wk  - MBS_Control,
  MBS_6wk_vs_Ctrl  = MBS_6wk  - MBS_Control,
  levels = design_group)

#identify specific apoptosis genes differentially expressed in pairwise contrasts
retrieve_apoptosis_DE_genes <- function(group1, group2, gene_set = apoptosis_genes$GeneID,
                                        fit = Testes_model_fit, design = design_group) {
  comparison <- paste0(group1, "_vs_", group2)
  con <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(group1, "-", group2), levels = design)
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = con)
  
  res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf, sort.by = "none")$table
  res <- res[rownames(res) %in% gene_set, ]
  res$FDR_set <- p.adjust(res$PValue, method = "BH")
  res$comparison <- comparison
  res$gene_ID <- rownames(res)
  
  sig <- res[res$FDR_set < fdr_cutoff & abs(res$logFC) > logFC_cutoff, ]
  message(nrow(sig), " apoptosis genes significantly DE in ", comparison)
  invisible(list(all = res, sig = sig))
}

#run function to identify specific apoptosis DE genes; there are none
comparisons <- list(
  c("KN_2day", "KN_Control"), c("KN_2wk", "KN_Control"), c("KN_6wk", "KN_Control"),
  c("MBS_2day", "MBS_Control"), c("MBS_2wk", "MBS_Control"), c("MBS_6wk", "MBS_Control"))
all_results <- lapply(comparisons, function(p) retrieve_apoptosis_DE_genes(p[1], p[2]))
names(all_results) <- sapply(comparisons, paste, collapse = "_vs_")

# start fry comparisons
idx <- which(rownames(dgeTestes) %in% apoptosis_genes$GeneID)
length(idx)

# use camera to assess if the apoptosis gene set has a shift in expression in response to hypoxia exposure relative to strain-specific controls
comp_test <- function(n, r = 0.01) {
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(Testes_model_fit, contrast = cons[, n])
  tt <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf, sort.by = "none")$table
  z <- setNames(sign(tt$logFC) * qnorm(tt$PValue / 2, lower.tail = FALSE), rownames(tt))
  cameraPR(z, list(apoptosis = which(rownames(tt) %in% apoptosis_genes$GeneID)), inter.gene.cor = r)
}
camera_out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(cons), function(n) cbind(contrast = n, comp_test(n))))
camera_out$FDR <- p.adjust(camera_out$PValue, "fdr")
camera_out

sapply(c(0, 0.01, 0.05), function(r) comp_test("MBS_2wk_vs_Ctrl", r)$PValue)

#calculate the shift in expression as measured by logFC relative to 0 days
apoptosis_expression_shift <- function(which_contrast) {
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(Testes_model_fit, contrast = cons[, which_contrast])
  tt <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf, sort.by = "none")$table
  ins <- rownames(tt) %in% apoptosis_genes$GeneID
  print(c(mean_logFC_set = mean(tt$logFC[ins]), mean_logFC_background = mean(tt$logFC[!ins]),
          pct_up_set = mean(tt$logFC[ins] > 0)))
  return(data.frame(gene = rownames(tt[ins,]),
                    contrast = which_contrast,
                    logFC = tt[ins,]$logFC))
}

#format apoptosis logFCs
```

```{r hub-genes}
# this function assesses which genes are in the top 1% and 5% of intramodule connectivity (kME) for each module to identify "hub" genes
get_hub_genes <- function(which_module) {
  module_df <- get(paste(which_module, "df", sep = "_"))
  
  colname_mm <- grep(paste("MM.",which_module, sep = ""), colnames(module_df), value = TRUE)
  
  module_mm <- module_df[,c("Gene", "moduleColor", colname_mm)]
  
  #set the threshold cutoffs
  module_hub_genes_cutoff_1 <- quantile(module_mm[,colname_mm], 0.99)  # top 1%
  module_hub_genes_cutoff_5 <- quantile(module_mm[,colname_mm], 0.95)  # top 5%
  
  #get gene ids
  module_hub_genes_top_1 <- module_mm[module_mm[,colname_mm] >= module_hub_genes_cutoff_1,]$Gene
  module_hub_genes_top_5 <- module_mm[module_mm[,colname_mm] >= module_hub_genes_cutoff_5,]$Gene
  
  # assess if hub genes are pbs outliers
  module_top_1_pbs_outliers <- pbs_outliers[pbs_outliers %in% module_hub_genes_top_1]
  module_top_5_pbs_outliers <- pbs_outliers[pbs_outliers %in% module_hub_genes_top_5]
  
  #write out hub genes to dfs
  assign(paste(which_module, "_hub_genes_top_1", sep = ""), module_hub_genes_top_1, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste(which_module, "_hub_genes_top_5", sep = ""), module_hub_genes_top_5, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  assign(paste(which_module, "_top_1_pbs_outliers", sep = ""), module_top_1_pbs_outliers, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste(which_module, "_top_5_pbs_outliers", sep = ""), module_top_5_pbs_outliers, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  #for each module, print the module name and who the hub genes are that are also pbs outliers
  print(which_module)
  print(module_top_5_pbs_outliers)
  
  #report if this module contains Hif1a or Epas1
  if("Hif1a" %in% module_hub_genes_top_5) {
    print(paste("Hif1a is a hub gene in the ", which_module, " module", sep = ""))
  }
  
  if("Epas1" %in% module_hub_genes_top_5) {
    print(paste("Epas1 is a hub gene in the ", which_module, " module", sep = ""))
  }
}

invisible(lapply(testes_module_color_info$testes_module_colors, get_hub_genes))
```

```{r green-deconvolution}
#load here so the package specific functions don't override others in the above code
suppressMessages(library(MuSiC)) # for in silico deconvolution
suppressMessages(library(Biobase)) # for in silico deconvolution
suppressMessages(library(SingleCellExperiment)) # for in silico deconvolution

# in silico deconvolution of samples using reference house mouse scRNAseq from Green et al. 2018
# import Green et al. data; folder does not contain these files due to GitHub size limits; user will need to download ST1-8
dge_files <- list.files("reference_files/Green_GSE112393_samples", 
                        pattern = "ST[0-9]_DGE\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
sample_ids <- gsub("^GSM[0-9]+_([A-Z]+[0-9]+)_DGE\\.txt", "\\1", basename(dge_files))

sapply(dge_files, function(f) names(data.table::fread(f, nrows = 0))[1])

#read in Green samples as sparse matrices
read_dge <- function(file) {
  example <- data.table::fread(file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  sample_id <- gsub(".*/GSM[0-9]+_([A-Z]+[0-9]+)_DGE\\.txt", "\\1", file)
  
  gene_ids <- example[[1]]          # first column, whatever it's named
  example[, 1] <- NULL              # drop it by position
  
  mat <- Matrix::Matrix(as.matrix(example), sparse = TRUE)
  rm(example); gc()
  
  rownames(mat) <- gene_ids
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(sample_id, "_", colnames(mat))
  mat
}

dge_matrices <- lapply(dge_files, read_dge)

# only keep genes in all ref samples
gene_lists <- lapply(dge_matrices, rownames)
all_genes <- Reduce(union, gene_lists)
sapply(gene_lists, function(g) sum(duplicated(g)))

# matrix formatting
align_to_union <- function(mat, all_genes) {
  triplet <- as(mat, "TsparseMatrix")           # extract (i, j, x) without densifying
  new_i <- match(rownames(mat)[triplet@i + 1], all_genes)
  Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = new_i, j = triplet@j + 1, x = triplet@x,
    dims = c(length(all_genes), ncol(mat)),
    dimnames = list(all_genes, colnames(mat))
  )
}

dge_matrices_aligned <- lapply(dge_matrices, align_to_union, all_genes = all_genes)
sc_counts <- do.call(cbind, dge_matrices_aligned)

message("Merged single-cell matrix: ", nrow(sc_counts), " genes x ", ncol(sc_counts), " cells")


# assemble a SCE (single cell experiment) object for compatibilitiy with MuSiC
cell_sample_ids <- rep(sample_ids, times = sapply(dge_matrices_aligned, ncol))

col_data <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(
  sample_id = cell_sample_ids,
  row.names = colnames(sc_counts))

row_data <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(
  gene_id = rownames(sc_counts),
  row.names = rownames(sc_counts)
)

sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = sc_counts),
  colData = col_data,
  rowData = row_data
)
sce

#import the cell population assignments for each cell from Green et al. 2018
attrs <- data.table::fread("reference_files/Green_GSE112393_samples/GSE112393_MergedAdultMouseST25_PerCellAttributes.txt")

#check distribution of cells across the 8 scRNAseq ref samples
sc_tab <- table(sub("_.*", "", colnames(sc_counts)))
matched_tab <- table(sub("_.*", "", intersect(colnames(sc_counts), attrs[["#CellBarcode"]])))

data.frame(
  total = sc_tab,
  matched = matched_tab[names(sc_tab)],
  pct = round(100 * matched_tab[names(sc_tab)] / sc_tab, 1)
)

#filter SCE object
ct_raw <- attrs[["CellType"]][match(colnames(sc_counts), attrs[["#CellBarcode"]])]
table(is.na(ct_raw))
#FALSE  TRUE 
#15826 15402 

keep <- !is.na(ct_raw)
sce <- sce[, keep]
sce$cellType <- factor(ct_raw[keep])


# make a key to go from cell population number to the biological state they assigned the population
cellType_key <- data.frame(num = seq(1, 11, 1),
                           cellType = c(
                             "InnateLymph",
                             "Macrophage",
                             "Endothelial",
                             "Myoid",
                             "Leydig",
                             "Sertoli",
                             "Unknown",
                             "spermatogonia",
                             "spermatocytes",
                             "round_spermatids",
                             "elongating_spermatids"))

# factor and then report on number of cells in each population
sce$cellType <- factor(
  cellType_key$cellType[match(as.integer(as.character(sce$cellType)), cellType_key$num)],
  levels = cellType_key$cellType
)

table(sce$cellType)

# estimate cell type proportions with music
Est.prop.testes <- music_prop(
  bulk.mtx  = as.matrix(count_data_testes),
  sc.sce    = sce,
  clusters  = "cellType",
  samples   = "sample_id",  
  verbose   = TRUE
)

# visualize similarity of Green et al. clusters if any need to be condensed (we did not condense any for this analysis)
testes.basis = music_basis(sce, clusters = 'cellType', samples = 'sample_id')

# Plot the dendrogram of design matrix and cross-subject mean of realtive abundance
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
d <- dist(t(log(testes.basis$Disgn.mtx + 1e-6)), method = "euclidean")
# Hierarchical clustering using Complete Linkage
hc1 <- hclust(d, method = "complete" )
# Plot the obtained dendrogram
plot(hc1, cex = 0.6, hang = -1, main = 'Cluster log(Design Matrix)')
d <- dist(t(log(testes.basis$M.theta + 1e-8)), method = "euclidean")
# Hierarchical clustering using Complete Linkage
# hc2 <- hclust(d, method = "complete" )
hc2 <- hclust(d, method = "complete")
# Plot the obtained dendrogram
plot(hc2, cex = 0.6, hang = -1, main = 'Cluster log(Mean of RA)')


# make a dataframe of estimated cell type proportions for each population
est_prop_long <- data.frame(Est.prop.testes$Est.prop.weighted)
est_prop_long$mouse_id <- rownames(est_prop_long)
est_prop_long <- pivot_longer(est_prop_long,
                              cols = grep("mouse_id", colnames(est_prop_long), invert = TRUE),
                              values_to = "proportion",
                              names_to = "cell_type")
est_prop_long <- merge(est_prop_long, phenotypes, by = "mouse_id")

cell_type_order <- c("Sertoli",
                     "spermatogonia",
                     "spermatocytes",
                     "round_spermatids",
                     "elongating_spermatids",
                     "Leydig",
                     "InnateLymph",
                     "Macrophage",
                     "Endothelial",
                     "Myoid",
                     "Unknown")
est_prop_long$cell_type <- factor(est_prop_long$cell_type, levels = rev(cell_type_order))

# make summary df
est_prop_long <- est_prop_long %>%
  group_by(strain, acclimation) %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = factor(mouse_id, levels = unique(mouse_id))) %>%
  ungroup()

# make a dataframe of estimated cell type proportions for each population as estimated by NNLS
nnls_prop_long <- data.frame(Est.prop.testes$Est.prop.allgene)
nnls_prop_long$mouse_id <- rownames(nnls_prop_long)
nnls_prop_long <- pivot_longer(nnls_prop_long,
                               cols = grep("mouse_id", colnames(nnls_prop_long), invert = TRUE),
                               values_to = "nnls",
                               names_to = "cell_type")
nnls_prop_long <- merge(nnls_prop_long, phenotypes, by = "mouse_id")

nnls_prop_long$cell_type <- factor(nnls_prop_long$cell_type, levels = rev(cell_type_order))

#summary dataframe
nnls_prop_long <- nnls_prop_long %>%
  group_by(strain, acclimation) %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = factor(mouse_id, levels = unique(mouse_id))) %>%
  ungroup()


#reorder phenotypes for plotting by normalized sperm count within each group
phenotypes <- phenotypes %>%
  mutate(
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("KN", "MBS")),
    acclimation = factor(acclimation, levels = c("Control", "2day", "2wk", "6wk"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(strain, acclimation, desc(Normalized_Sperm_Count))

heatmap_row_order <- phenotypes$mouse_id

#create a vector of shades of brown for the heatmap
browns_col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(0, 1, length.out = length(browns)), browns)

#create a heatmap for each group of the estimated cell type proportions from music
comp_specific_music_heatmap <- function(which_comp) {
  grep_pattern <- gsub("_", ".*", which_comp)
  
  example_music_heatmap <- Heatmap(as.matrix(Est.prop.testes$Est.prop.weighted
                                             [grep(grep_pattern, 
                                                   rownames(Est.prop.testes$Est.prop.weighted)),]), 
                                   name = "Cell type proportion", 
                                   column_order = cell_type_order[cell_type_order %in% colnames(Est.prop.testes$Est.prop.weighted)], 
                                   row_order = grep(grep_pattern, heatmap_row_order, value = TRUE),
                                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=4), 
                                   show_row_names = FALSE, 
                                   col = browns_col_fun, 
                                   show_row_dend = FALSE, 
                                   cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                                   use_raster = FALSE,
                                   border = TRUE,
                                   row_title = which_comp,
                                   row_title_side = "left",
                                   row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
                                   row_title_rot = 90)
}

music_heatmap_list <- lapply(unique(phenotypes$comp), comp_specific_music_heatmap)

#create a heatmap for each group of the estimated cell type proportions from NNLS
comp_specific_nnls_heatmap <- function(which_comp) {

                                            [grep(grep_pattern,

                                  row_title = which_comp,
                                  row_title_side = "left",
                                  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
                                  row_title_rot = 90)
}


nnls_heatmap_list <- lapply(unique(phenotypes$comp), comp_specific_nnls_heatmap)


# get the actual heatmap objects using mget, then convert each to a grob
music_heatmap_grobs <- lapply(music_heatmap_list, function(ht) {

# combine to make figure S3
```

```{r cell-type-proportion-stats}
# running beta regression on four cell types of interest to assess if their proportions are correlated with noramlized sperm count
cell_types <- c("Sertoli", "spermatogonia", "spermatocytes", "elongating_spermatids")

# rescale X (divide by 1000) so coefficients are readable and optimizer is stable
est_prop_long <- est_prop_long %>%
  mutate(Sperm_Count_k = Normalized_Sperm_Count / 1000)

# Smithson & Verkuilen (2006) transformation; this is because some estimated cell type proportions are exactly zero which doesn't work with beta regression
transform_prop <- function(y) {
  n <- length(y)
  (y * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
}

#apply the transformation
est_prop_long <- est_prop_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  mutate(proportion_adj = transform_prop(proportion)) %>%
  ungroup()

est_prop_long$cell_type <- factor(est_prop_long$cell_type,
                                  levels = rev(cell_type_order))

# refit all 4 cell population beta regression models with rescaled predictor
models <- map(cell_types, function(ct) {
  d <- est_prop_long[est_prop_long$cell_type == ct, ]
  betareg(proportion_adj ~ Sperm_Count_k * strain, data = d)
})
names(models) <- cell_types

# check convergence for all 4
walk(cell_types, function(ct) {
  cat(ct, "- converged:", models[[ct]]$converged, 
      "| iterations:", models[[ct]]$optim$iterations %||% NA, "\n")
})

# create a summary results table with rescaled coefficients
results_table <- map_dfr(cell_types, function(ct) {
  s <- summary(models[[ct]])$coefficients$mean
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    term      = rownames(s),
    estimate  = s[, "Estimate"],
    p_value   = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL
  )
})

results_table <- results_table %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

print(results_table)

# reformat results table for easy plot labels 
annot_df <- results_table %>%
  filter(term %in% c("strainMBS", "Sperm_Count_k:strainMBS")) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    term_label = case_when(
      term == "strainMBS" ~ "Strain",
      term == "Sperm_Count_k:strainMBS" ~ "Interaction"
    ),
    line = paste0(term_label, ": β = ", round(estimate, 2),
                  ", p = ", formatC(p_adj, format = "e", digits = 1),
                  " ", sig)
  ) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(label = paste(line, collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop")

# create summary plots for the four targetted cell populations of estimated proportion by normalized sperm count
targeted_est_prop_long <- est_prop_long[est_prop_long$cell_type %in% cell_types,]
targeted_est_prop_long$cell_type <- factor(targeted_est_prop_long$cell_type,
                                           levels = cell_type_order)
annot_df$cell_type <- factor(annot_df$cell_type,
                             levels = cell_types)

combined_cells_summary_plots <-
  ggplot(targeted_est_prop_long, 
         aes(x = Normalized_Sperm_Count, y = proportion_adj, color = comp)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = all_combo_colors) +
  geom_text(
    data = annot_df,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 2.8,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, nrow =1,
             labeller = labeller(cell_type = c(
               "Sertoli"               = "Sertoli",
               "spermatogonia"         = "Spermatogonia",
               "spermatocytes"         = "Spermatocytes",
               "elongating_spermatids" = "Elongating spermatids"
             ))) +
  ylim(0,1) +
  ylab("Cell type proportion") +
  xlab("Sperm count (10e6)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"))
```
